platform.title: Admin cabinet
platform.lede: Every workspace, run and user on this server. Workspaces show metadata only: their tickets are their members'.
platform.full: Full: runs are waiting for the server
platform.noQueue: No run is waiting for the server.
platform.forbidden: Only an Admin can open the operator console.
platform.dashLede: Everyone on the platform, how fast it grows, and what the server is running.
platform.activeNote: Signed in during the last 7 days
platform.teams: {n, plural, one {# with a team} other {# with teams}}
platform.runsNow: {n, plural, one {# run right now} other {# runs right now}}
platform.growthSub: New accounts and workspaces per day, last {n} days
platform.wsLede: Every workspace and who is in it. You see metadata only: tickets and code belong to the workspace’s members.
platform.suspendBody: Its runs stop being started and its members see that the workspace is suspended. You can resume it at any time.
platform.usersLede: Everyone who signed up with Google: their workspaces, and when they were last here. Admin accounts are on the Admins page.
platform.searchUsers: Search by name, email or workspace
platform.makeAdminBody: Admins open this cabinet: they see every user and workspace, change plans and credits, suspend workspaces and manage other Admins.
platform.removeAdminBody: They keep their account and workspaces, but lose the Admin cabinet.
platform.adminsLede: The platform’s operators. Each is its own account, apart from Users: an Admin sees no workspace’s tickets.
platform.addAdminSub: An Admin is a separate account: it signs in with a password, opens this cabinet and has no workspaces. Users can’t be made Admins.
platform.noMatch: No one matches, or they are an Admin already.
platform.adminPasswordHint: At least {n} characters. They can turn on two-factor sign-in in their profile.
platform.deleteAdminBody: They can no longer sign in. This cannot be undone.
platform.freeCreditsWorth: Worth {amount} of model calls on agnts's Muse key.
platform.freeCreditsInvalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to 10,000,000.
platform.limitSet: {name} may spend up to {n} credits ({amount}) a month
platform.museProviderSub: Where runs on agnts's credits go. People's own Meta accounts are not affected.
platform.mpNote_auto: agnts's Meta key. When it runs out, runs continue their session on {name}.
platform.mpNote_primary: agnts's Meta key only. Runs stop when it runs out.
platform.mpNote_fallback: Every run on credits goes to {name}.
platform.mpNone: This server has no fallback provider (AGNTS_MUSE_FALLBACK_KEY).
platform.limitField: Credits per month (1 credit = $0.01; 0 is no limit)
platform.limitHelp: Free and workspace credits together. Runs stop once it is spent and resume next month or when you raise it.
platform.limitWorth: Up to {amount} of model calls a month.
platform.limitNone: No limit: only their credits bound what they spend.
platform.fbField: Credits per month on {name} (0 is no limit)
platform.fbHelp: Free for them: runs use {name} when their own Meta account or agnts's is at its limit. When it is used up, their runs continue on credits.
platform.usageTotals: This month: {used} credits ({amount}) across everyone; {limited} people have a limit.
